lines.text: Adam was standing right next to her… and he didn't say a word.
We always blame Eve. But read it slowly.
“She took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.”
With her. He was there the whole time.
He heard the snake. He watched her reach. And he said nothing.
That evening, they heard God walking in the garden… and they hid.
God called: “Where art thou?”
And Adam said: “The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.”
phrases: she gave me of the tree,

lines.text: He blamed her. And he blamed God.
Then Eve said: “The serpent beguiled me.”
Everyone pointed at someone else.
We still do it. My parents. My friends. My past. Even God.
But notice. God didn't call Eve first. He called Adam.
The Bible says: “By one man sin entered into the world.”
Thousands of years later… another Man stood in a garden.
Soldiers came with torches. And He didn't hide. He stepped forward: “I am he.”
Then He said: “Let these go their way.” He protected His friends.
Adam hid and passed the blame. Jesus stepped out… and took it.
“He hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin.”
So stop passing it. Just bring it to Him.
Who do you blame for your mistakes? Be honest.
